# First run, as a brand-new user
start app.kurotoon.dev
sleep 6
shot welcome
tapuntil Next "Select a folder"
shot storage
tapuntil "Select a folder" "Use this folder" 4
shot picker
tap "More options" 20
tap "New folder"
shot newfolder
type Kurotoon
tapx OK
sleep 3
tap "Use this folder" 15
sleep 2
shot picker_allow
tap Allow
sleep 3
shot storage_done
tapuntil Next "Get started" 6
shot guides
tapuntil "Get started" Library 4
sleep 4
shot home_empty
tapx Browse
sleep 2
shot browse_empty
tapx Library
shot library_empty
tapx Updates
shot updates_empty
tapx Me
shot me_new
tapx Home
# Add the community extension store through the standard repo link
view "tachiyomi://add-repo?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keiyoushi/extensions/repo/index.min.json"
sleep 4
shot addrepo_dialog
tapx Add
sleep 5
shot store_added
start app.kurotoon.dev
sleep 3
tapx Home
tap "Add sources"
sleep 8
shot extensions
# Android asks once before KuroToon may install extensions
tap "Tap here to grant"
sleep 3
shot grant_settings
tap "Allow from this source"
sleep 2
shot grant_on
back
sleep 2
shot extensions_granted
tap Search
type MangaDex
sleep 4
shot ext_search
tapx Install
sleep 15
shot install_prompt
tapif INSTALL
tapif Install
sleep 25
shot installed
